summary: Tested the 5 HR unit role presets (hr_manager, finance_manager, services_manager, hr_secretary, regular_employee) and the automatic hr_scope=MY_UNIT. Backend: 23/23 new pytest tests passed, and the 16/16 regression tests in test_unit_isolation_hr_scope.py still pass. Frontend: on /manage-roles the 'إنشاء / تحديث' button calls POST /api/roles/hr-presets, which returns 200 and creates or updates 9 roles. The 5 role cards show the right permission counts (12/7/8/3/0). Creating a user with 'المدير المالي' from /manage-users works: hr_scope is MY_UNIT, confirmed through GET /api/hr/users/{id}/scope. One UI bug: on web no success message appears after the preset buttons are clicked.

minor.issue: If a user moves from one of the 5 preset roles to an unrestricted role (for example hr_officer or a custom role), hr_scope stays at MY_UNIT. This is consistent with 'never override', but admins may not expect it.
Returns 'ALL' when hr_scope is null, so the API cannot tell 'no scope set yet' from an explicit 'ALL'. This makes the 'only if not set' rule hard to see from the UI.

ui_bugs.component: manage-roles HR presets / Admin presets buttons
ui_bugs.issue: onPress uses Alert.alert, which does nothing on react-native-web. On web the user gets no success or error message after 'إنشاء / تحديث' (POST returns 200, but no dialog or toast appears; confirmed in Playwright, dialogs=[]). manage-users already uses window.alert when Platform.OS==='web'; the same pattern is needed here.

issues: A new user given a preset role gets MY_UNIT, but has no linked employee record or org unit yet. Their effective scope is empty ('لا توجد وحدة محددة', units_count=0), so they see no HR, fee or letter data. This fails closed by design, but the UI does not warn the admin to link the user to an employee or unit.

action_items: manage-roles.tsx: show success and error messages on web for the preset buttons (window.alert or a toast when Platform.OS==='web'). This applies to both create-hr-presets-btn and create-admin-presets-btn.
Optional: after a user is created or edited with a preset role and has no linked employee or unit, show a hint that their MY_UNIT scope is currently empty.
critical_code_review_comments: create_hr_role_presets matches existing roles by preset_key OR name. An unrelated custom role that happens to be named 'سكرتير المدير' or 'الموظف العادي' would be silently taken over and get its permissions overwritten.
In both POST and PUT /api/users, the auto-scope sets hr_scope_unit_ids=[] when it applies. That is correct, but there is no audit or activity-log entry recording the automatic scope assignment.
Regression check for existing hr_manager users was vacuous: no users are currently assigned the hr_manager preset role (0 found). The code path (presets only update db.roles) does not touch users.
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/manage-roles.tsx (changed data-testid to testID on create-hr-presets-btn and create-admin-presets-btn so the testid actually renders on RN-web)

success_rate.frontend: 90% (flows work; success message missing on web)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Test users TEST_hrp_* and TEST_ui_fin_mgr were created and deleted. The 9 HR preset roles and the admin presets stay in place (as requested).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_hr_role_presets_default_scope.py -v (it cleans up its own users). The presets endpoint is idempotent: a second call gives 0 created / 9 updated. Login UI: fill the placeholders, then click the text 'تسجيل الدخول'.
